label: MiniMax-H3 Ref2V+A
prompt: The person in the reference image walks forward through a sunlit corridor, speaking to camera, footsteps and voice audible.

default.description: Model-default topology; validate before publishing on hardware without a dedicated profile below.
default.notes: Ref2VA partition: the reference image arrives as a conditions[] entry with role=reference (see configs/sample/minimax_h3.py), which is what selects the ref2va checkpoint. Same parallelism as the t2va profile; added 2026-08-26 to cover the second H3 serving mode for single-request latency.
default.policy_exception: Correctness exception, not a speed tradeoff: MiniMax-H3's torch.compile path changes numerical output per the sglang cookbook (docs/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3.mdx, checked 2026-08-07) -- compile is not enabled by any recommended lossless preset for this model and must not be used to generate consistency ground truth. --enable-torch-compile stays false in every profile for this case until upstream fixes the numerics.

rtx5090-2gpu.description: 2x RTX 5090 (32 GB) layerwise-offload recipe -- the lightweight, broadly-runnable topology for this case.
rtx5090-2gpu.serve_args: --model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --model-variant ref2va --tp-size 2 --ulysses-degree 1 --performance-mode memory --layerwise-offload-components dit,text_encoder,vae --dit-offload-prefetch-size 1 --dit-layerwise-resident-layers 20 --enable-torch-compile false

default.description: vLLM-Omni's own 2-GPU MiniMax-H3 recipe (TP2, distributed layerwise offload, compile path). Reaches health and accepts a request, then crashes during generation -- kept for provenance, not a working profile on any GPU class tested so far.
default.framework_ref: vllm-omni recipes/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3.md (2-GPU section); installed from git main (0.26.1.dev45+g24ede9e22 on RTX 5090, 0.26.1.dev50+gcfa6d66ed on B200) + vllm==0.26.0, not the repo's default pinned vllm-omni==0.18.0
default.notes: Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH for MP4 muxing. The request also needs `aspect_ratio` inside extra_params (the recipe's own T2VA example omits it and 422s with 'RuntimeError: t2va requires an explicit aspect_ratio' as written). CONFIRMED HARDWARE-INDEPENDENT 2026-08-07: re-ran this exact profile on 2xB200 (sm100, datacenter Blackwell) -- it segfaults with the identical signature as on RTX 5090 (native segfault, Python trace through torch Dynamo's custom_eval_frame), 1 step into denoising. Same bug on two unrelated GPU architectures rules out a consumer-GPU/SM120 quirk; this is a real vLLM-Omni MiniMax-H3 stability bug in the compiled path, not something fixable from the benchmark harness. Use the enforce-eager / b200-2gpu profile instead.

enforce-eager.description: Same recipe with --enforce-eager, tried after the default profile segfaulted. Fails differently (and earlier) on RTX 5090, but is the profile that actually works on B200 -- see command_profiles.b200-2gpu.
enforce-eager.notes: On RTX 5090 this crashes during server startup (EOFError: a diffusion worker process dies before completing its init handshake) rather than during generation, and never reaches a request. UPDATE 2026-08-07: the identical flags reach health and complete a real generation on 2xB200 -- see command_profiles.b200-2gpu for the hardware-scoped, validated version of this same command.

b200-2gpu.description: 2x B200, same recipe as enforce-eager -- the profile that actually completes a generation for this case.
b200-2gpu.framework_ref: vllm-omni recipes/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3.md (2-GPU section) + --enforce-eager; git main 0.26.1.dev50+gcfa6d66ed + vllm==0.26.0
b200-2gpu.notes: Validated 2026-08-07 on 2xB200 (h3-b200-2gpu-v2): completes the case's T2VA request end to end -- client wall 105.76s, server-reported inference_time_s 103.06, peak_memory_mb 24546. Output verified with ffprobe directly on the returned MP4: 124 frames @ 24 fps = 5.166667s, exactly matching the requested 5s/124-frame shape (the API's own JSON `seconds` field reported a stale '4' on both the submit and completed response -- a cosmetic metadata default unrelated to the real generation params, not a real duration shortfall; confirmed by decoding the actual file). Still uses the recipe's memory-constrained --dlo-resident-layers 20 offload even though B200's 183 GB has no need for it -- vllm-omni ships only one documented 2-GPU H3 recipe, so this is that recipe as-is, not a B200-tuned command; a fully-resident vllm-omni command may be faster but is not a documented starting point. Same request, same 2xB200 hardware, sglang's b200-2gpu profile: 80.64s/80.63s client wall, 75.42s inference_time_s -- sglang is ~1.31x faster than vLLM-Omni here.

vllm-omni.reason: Empirically validated 2026-08-07, first on minimax-h3-5090-2gpu-v4 (2x RTX 5090) then on 2xB200: the default (compiled) profile segfaults identically on both GPU classes 1 step into denoising (see command_profiles.default.notes) -- a confirmed hardware-independent vLLM-Omni bug, despite the recipe's own claim that torch.compile is 'not enabled by default on consumer paths.' --enforce-eager avoids that segfault, but on RTX 5090 it fails differently at startup (a diffusion worker process dies before completing its init handshake, surfaced as EOFError) and never completes a request on that GPU class. On 2xB200 the identical --enforce-eager command works cleanly and completes a correct generation -- see command_profiles.b200-2gpu for the validated numbers and the sglang comparison on the same hardware. Net: vLLM-Omni H3 support is real but fragile below the B200 class tested here; RTX 5090 has no working profile for this case in either variant.

lightx2v.reason: No MiniMax-H3 pipeline in LightX2V as of 2026-08; a turbo LoRA effort for H3 was blocked by the model license's territory clause (excludes EU/UK/South Korea/US), not by missing engineering support.

trtllm-visual.reason: trtllm-visual's tracked scope in this harness is image cases; H3 is a video+audio model.

diffusers.reason: MiniMax-H3 is integrated as Modular Diffusers blocks only (no DiffusionPipeline), and only via an unmerged PR (huggingface/diffusers#14355 -- pip install git+.../diffusers.git@refs/pull/14355/head). Not a servable baseline path today.

_note: Ref2VA is selected by the conditions[] entry with role=reference, not by the harness's reference_image multipart path; __TEST_IMAGE_URL__ is substituted with meta.test_image_url at request time.
